knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: factor-of-2 constant in szemeredi_implies_fk is improvable to 1. Proved pair_cut_error_bound_sharp (ε|P||Q|) and szemeredi_implies_fk_sharp (ε-cut-approximation), 0 sorry 0 axiom, builds green.

insights: The factor of 2 came ONLY from the small-subset case of the per-pair bound, where the original used |e - d|A||B|| ≤ e + d|A||B| ≤ 2ε|P||Q| (sum/triangle).
In the small case both e and d|A||B| are individually ≤ |A||B| ≤ ε|P||Q|, so |x-y| ≤ max(x,y) for nonneg x,y gives ε|P||Q| directly — factor 1.
The large-subset case already delivered ε|P||Q| from ε-regularity, so 1 is optimal for this case analysis.
The improvement is local to the per-pair lemma; the partition decomposition and Σ|Pi||Pj|=n^2 identity are reused unchanged.
Corrects parent szemeredi-regularity-oq-02 keyInsight that the factor of 2 is sharp/irreducible under this strategy.
nextSteps: Open: matching lower bound — is there a graph + ε-regular partition with cut-approx error asymptotically ε·n^2, certifying constant 1 is tight (not merely reachable)?
